text_block_list.text:
It happened right after summer camp ended.
I was at the airport to see off Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
and her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...The next time El-chan comes home
will be after everything is over, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle of the world, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
There, El shall soar high into the heavens!
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe: the grand festival held in Paris, France to decide the world's best.

There have been famous Japanese Umamusume
who challenged that peak in the past as well.

The result was... unplaced. 18th place. 14th place.
It is a history of challenging and being kicked down time and time again.
Yet, it remains the summit that Japan's Umamusume strive to conquer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "No matter how reckless people say this challenge is, if it's El... you'll still go for it, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then go out there and leave a magnificent set of hoofprints!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Wishing the best of luck to you all too!
Grass and King, you're both running
in the Mainichi Okan, yes?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"And by coincidence,
Spe-chan and Tsuru-chan
are running in the Kyoto Daishoten on the exact same day."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right! And by then,
El-chan's "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" will be over.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The next time all of us gather together will be after every one of us has grown to the next level.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...All right, here goes—!

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text:
Have a safe trip, El-chan!
Have a great time, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm off, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“And today we have the GⅡ Kyoto Daishoten!
A massive crowd of racing fans has flooded Yodo!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"While everyone's eyes are on the Mainichi Okan in the East,
the clash of classmates in the West is just as thrilling!
Here come the Umamusume!"
—Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi has friends.
Some friends have challenged the world, while others compete on different turf.

"Above all, I have a friend to compete with in this land.
...A rival I can call a friend."
Today is the day of the Kyoto Daishoten.
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, you can go toe-to-toe with your rivals
Tsuyoshi, you can stand on equal footing with your rivals

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: How it felt out there today is proof that you've gotten stronger
How it felt out there today is proof of just how much stronger you've become

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!
choice_data_list: Get out there and give it everything you've got, Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
I won't lose to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Let's introduce today's runners!
The one who brought the Spring Shield to the Mejiro family, Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Towaaa~.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Looking to build momentum heading into the autumn!
This year's Satsuki Sho victor, T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Let this match become another jewel upon my crown as the 'Overlord'! A comedy... must always end with the protagonist's victory."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And more than anything, these two!
The fighting spirit of these classmates, under the spotlight
since before autumn, is finally unleashed!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Tsuru-chan,
did you see El-chan's results?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I saw.
...But today is our race day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah, you're right.
...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I take 1st place!
I even skipped lunch! Being a little hungry
actually helps me focus better!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Even the big eater Spe-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
...Because I'm going to take them down.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Today I will win, and you will lose.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No, it's the other way around. You are going to lose to me.
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Let me tell you this! I am "definitely"
stronger than any unbeatable rival!
